## F — Research and VERIFY index for Sharing the road and work zones
Coverage: C contains 53 facts and C2 contains 32 facts from physical pages 58, 59, 60, 61, 62, 63, 64.
VERIFY PA-sec12-A-FRESH: current legal applicability of the old edition (EvidenceLibrarian).
VERIFY PA-sec12-A-EFFECTIVE: effective date is absent (EvidenceLibrarian).
VERIFY PA-sec12-A-PERCENT: no official percentage is asserted (EvidenceLibrarian).
VERIFY PA-sec12-A-TIME: time limit is unknown (EvidenceLibrarian).
VERIFY PA-SHARING-MARKET: demand research (SMEResearchAgent).
VERIFY PA-SHARING-TEARDOWN: competitor research (SMEResearchAgent).
Preaccept source review is recorded per fact in scratch; independent QA is outstanding.
VERIFY PA-SHARING-CURRENTNESS: Unperioded work-zone/rail/aggressive-driving crash statistics on58,59,64 and511PA service availability are not asserted as current stable facts.
VERIFY PA-SHARING-OPEN-BED: Physical63 says open-bed occupancy bars speeds above35mph and children under18, then exceptions begin: farmer's child for farm work. Physical64 continues farm-employee child, licensed child hunter between camp/sites during season, and officially sanctioned parade participant during parade. Whole rule and exceptions retained as debt rather than guessing exception reach across the two prohibitions.
VERIFY PA-SHARING-MOVEOVER-DETAILS: Physical63 has an ambiguous at-least-two-lamps/other-markers definition and overlapping general harm penalties90days/up-to1000dollars, protected-person serious injury6months/up-to5000, protected-person death1year/up-to10000. Exact current legal scope needs resolution before learner assertion.
VERIFY PA-SHARING-TURBULENCE: Physical61 claims truck wind turbulence pushes vehicles apart and never pulls them together. This absolute directional claim is withheld pending contextual physics/source verification.
